description: NaVF₆N₂ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight N₂ clusters inside a NaVF₆ framework. In each N₂ cluster, N is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaVF₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent VF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.41 Å. V is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form VF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All V-F bond lengths are 1.82 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one V atom.
